title: Dominic and the Smile
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
